data.name: Durand
data.gender_notes: Durand is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German words 'thuri' meaning fortress and 'hands' meaning ruler or protector. Durand was a common name among the Germanic peoples, particularly among the knights and nobles. The name is believed to signify strength, protection, and leadership. The name Durand carries the meaning “The ruler of the fortress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Durand usually hope their child will grow to embody the ruler of the fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durand total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
